title: Luxury SoBro Retreat•Walk to Broadway•Rooftop Pool
description:
Welcome to your Nashville home away from home! 🏙️ Located in SoBro, this stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment is just minutes from Downtown and Broadway. Enjoy easy access to live music, restaurants, nightlife, Bridgestone Arena, Music City Center, Nissan Stadium, The Gulch, and more. Relax in a modern space with a full kitchen, Wi-Fi, Smart TV, washer/dryer, and fitness amenities. 🎶✨

The space
Modern 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment
Full kitchen, living room
Great downtown Nashville views
Free Wi-Fi
Access to building amenities
Paid parking available nearby, with a private parking option available for an additional fee
Located in SoBro, close to Broadway, restaurants, bars, and attractions
Quiet residential building—please be respectful of neighbors
No smoking or pets
Maximum of 4 guests

Other things to note
Parking: A private parking space in the building’s garage is available for $25 per night. Parking can be added through the guest portal provided in your booking confirmation message.

Building Access: The building has secure, controlled access. Check-in instructions and access information will be provided before your arrival.

Early Check-In & Late Check-Out: Early check-in and late check-out may be available for an additional fee. These options can be purchased through the guest portal provided in your booking confirmation message.
